description: This file defines a custom exception class 'UploadedFileErrorException' in the Laminas Diactoros library, specifically for handling errors related to uploaded files.

classes.name: UploadedFileErrorException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing errors occurring during file upload operations.

methods.name: forUnmovableFile
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating an error occurred while moving the uploaded file.

methods.name: dueToStreamUploadError
methods.description: Creates an instance for upload errors related to stream retrieval, accepting an error message.

methods.name: dueToUnwritablePath
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating the designated path for upload is unwritable.

methods.name: dueToUnwritableTarget
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating the target directory does not exist or is not writable, including the directory path.
